copy.title: Greenway Landscapes — Landscaping, Retaining Walls & Decking, Hills District Sydney
copy.description: Landscaping across The Hills District and north-west Sydney. Retaining walls, timber decking, paving, lawns and turf, drainage and irrigation. A family business since 1987, licence 157365C. Free on-site quote — call Trent on 0418 607 124.
copy.headline:
Every trade
your yard needs,
on one licence.
copy.sub: Retaining walls, decks, paving, turf, drainage and irrigation. A family business since 1987 on licence 157365C — and Trent is the one who turns up. Free on-site quote across the Hills District and north-west Sydney.
copy.statementBody: A deck wants a chippie. A wall wants a waller. A wet corner wants someone who can read where the water goes. One Greenway job covered drainage, mulching, steel edging and welding, a drip sprinkler system and earthworks with machinery — and it was the same crew for the lot.
copy.servicesHeadline:
The whole yard,
not one part of it.
copy.servicesIntro: Greenway build the hard parts and the green parts. Retaining walls, decks and paving; turf, garden beds and the drainage underneath them. Water features and garden lighting as well.
copy.apertureLine: One licence. Every trade the yard needs.
copy.workIntro: Sandstone terraces and a herringbone driveway. A cabana in hardwood. Turf laid against a sandstone escarpment. Path lighting at dusk. All the same contractor.
copy.processHeadline:
Four steps,
and the quote is free.
copy.processIntro: Greenway quote on site, at no charge. You know the number before anything is dug.
copy.reviewsIntro: A 5.0 average from sixteen Google reviews. Every review below names Trent, and several describe him doing the work himself.
copy.recognitionHeadline:
Licensed, insured,
and answerable to two bodies.
copy.recognitionIntro: Licence 157365C sits at the foot of every page of their own site. They are current members of the Housing Industry Association and the Landscape Association NSW & ACT, and in 2004 they won the Landscape category in the Australian Achiever awards for Excellence in Customer Service.
copy.areasHeadline:
The Hills District,
and out from there.
copy.areasIntro: In Greenway's own words: serving Sydney Metro, north-west and the Hills District. Their post goes to a Castle Hill box. Ask Trent how far he travels for a job like yours.
copy.enquireIntro: The more you can say about the block — the slope, the corner that stays wet, what you actually want out there — the more useful the first visit will be. Photos help.

Greenway organise a free on-site quotation. Trent walks the block with you and quotes on what he finds, not on what you described over the phone.
Affordable and upfront pricing, in their own words. You know the number before anything is dug.
Trent and his team do the work. Large or small — Greenway take both, residential and commercial, and one reviewer's job was a deck and a turfed nature strip.

reviews.name: graeme gill
reviews.text: Trent came and replaced our deck and turfed our nature strip. He did an excellent job. Careful, efficient, high quality worksmanship and a pleasure to have around, we would recommend him without qualification for any landscaping needs.

reviews.name: Ashley Blacker
reviews.text: Trent and his team are phenomenal! Extremely experienced and knowledgeable. Our project involved identifying and resolving drainage issues, general garden mulching, steel edging / welding, drip sprinkler system, earthworks using machinery and more. Wide ranging skills. faq.q: Do you come out and quote?
faq.a: Yes, and it costs nothing. Greenway's own words are that they will organise a free on-site quotation. Trent comes to the property, looks at the ground and quotes on what he finds there.

faq.q: How small a job will you take?
faq.a: Small is fine. Their site says large and small scale projects, residential and commercial. One of their Google reviews is a replaced deck and a turfed nature strip.

faq.q: Our side yard floods. Can that be sorted before anything is planted?
faq.a: That is the order Trent works in. One client's review describes him listening to their concerns about a side area flooding, then putting in extra drainage pipes and bigger river rocks and redesigning the area around it. Another lists identifying and resolving drainage issues among the work done on their job.

Licence 157365C, printed at the foot of every page of their own site. Their about page lists public liability, workers' compensation and eligibility for Builders Warranty Insurance, and they are current members of the Housing Industry Association and the Landscape Association NSW & ACT.
The Hills District, Sydney's north-west and the Sydney metro area, in their own words. Their post goes to a box at Castle Hill. If you are not sure whether you are in range, ring Trent and ask.

faq.q: Do you do the whole yard, or just the one part of it?
faq.a: Either. Greenway's own list runs from paving and driveways to pool surrounds, garden design and construction, irrigation and water features, pergolas, retaining walls and excavation work. One Google review describes a single job that covered drainage, garden mulching, steel edging and welding, a drip sprinkler system and earthworks using machinery.

faq.q: How long have you been going?
faq.a: A family business established in 1987. Their site says over thirty years' experience, and in 2004 Greenway won the Landscape category in the Australian Achiever awards for Excellence in Customer Service.

_source.aboutText:
Greenway Landscapes is a family business established in 1987. One of our priorities is quality of workmanship and we make sure the job is done properly the first time without cutting corners.

We also place great importance on communication with clients and good service which was recognized in 2004 when Greenway Landscapes won the Landscape category in the Australian Achiever awards for Excellence in Customer Service. Our business has all the required licenses and insurance in place including public liability, workers’ compensation and eligibility for Builders Warranty Insurance.

We are also current members of the Housing Industry Association and the Landscape Association NSW & ACT.

Greenway Landscapes can meet your needs in all aspects of Landscape construction including paving, retaining walls, driveways, drainage and irrigation, water features, decking, pergolas, garden edging and construction and much more.

We are happy to be involved as little or as much as you would like with the design of your outdoor areas.

Residential & Commercial: Paving & Driveways, Pool Surrounds, Garden Design & Construction, Irrigation & Water Features, Pergolas, Retaining Walls, Excavation Work
